import numpy as np, pandas as pd
rng = np.random.default_rng(7)
n = 3000
k = rng.integers(0, 8, n)
centers = rng.normal(0, 7, (8, 20))
df = pd.DataFrame(centers[k] + rng.normal(0, 1, (n, 20)), columns=[f'x{i}' for i in range(20)])
df['cluster'] = pd.Categorical([f'C{v+1}' for v in k])
df.shape

steps.name: enable glow toggle
steps.eval: const display = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('label')).find(l => l.textContent.includes('Glow')); if (display) { const cb = display.querySelector('input[type=checkbox]'); cb.checked = true; cb.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); }

steps.name: baseline glow at 3k points
steps.eval: const times3k = []; for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) { const t0 = performance.now(); a.glowVersion++; await new Promise(r => requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(r))); times3k.push(Math.round(performance.now() - t0)); } window.__glow3kMs = Math.round(times3k.reduce((s,t)=>s+t,0)/times3k.length); window.__glow3kTimes = times3k
steps.report: { nPoints: a.nAnchors, times_ms: window.__glow3kTimes, avg_ms: window.__glow3kMs }

steps.name: inject 1M synthetic anchor positions and measure glow time
steps.eval: const N = 1_000_000; const xy = new Float32Array(N * 2); for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) { xy[i*2] = (Math.sin(i * 0.00613) * 0.4 + 0.5) * 400 + 200; xy[i*2+1] = (Math.cos(i * 0.00891) * 0.4 + 0.5) * 300 + 150; } const saved = { xy: a.anchorXY, n: a.nAnchors }; a.anchorXY = xy; a.nAnchors = N; const times1M = []; for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) { const t0 = performance.now(); a.glowVersion++; await new Promise(r => requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(r))); times1M.push(Math.round(performance.now() - t0)); } window.__glow1MMs = Math.round(times1M.reduce((s,t)=>s+t,0)/times1M.length); window.__glow1MTimes = times1M; a.anchorXY = saved.xy; a.nAnchors = saved.n
